text:
**Best all-around kit for van life: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200W solar panel.** It has a 2,073.6Wh battery—useful for a fridge, laptop, and other everyday loads—and comes with a folding panel, so you can start charging from solar without piecing together a setup. The listed price is $1,199 before any discount. [See the kit and buy](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit).

**The trade-off:** its included panel is only 200W, and its car-socket charging is listed at 96W, so neither is a particularly fast way to refill it. If you prioritize a lighter power station and higher solar-input capacity, the [Anker SOLIX C1000 Gen 2](https://powersized.com/best/rv/) is a strong van-focused alternative: 24.9 lb and up to 600W solar input, though that source doesn’t identify it as a panel-included kit.

**Bottom line:** choose the BLUETTI bundle for a ready-to-use, higher-capacity kit; choose the Anker if keeping weight down and adding more solar are bigger priorities.

judge.top_pick: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit (2,073.6 Wh, 2,600 W)
